description: This file defines functions related to HTTP/2 protocol constants, including string representations for frame types, flags, error codes, and settings parameters, as well as invalid header names.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Http2FrameType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Overloaded function converting uint8_t to string via casting to enum.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Converts frame type and flags to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Overloaded function converting type and flags (uint8_t) to string.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Overloaded function converting Http2ErrorCode enum to string.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Converts settings parameter value to string.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Overloaded function converting Http2SettingsParameter enum to string.

methods.name: GetInvalidHttp2HeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a set of invalid HTTP/2 header names based on a reloadable flag.
